description: Extract specific values from a web page as JSON instead of markdown prose. Provide CSS selectors to pull named fields (text or an attribute, first match or all), and/or set tables:true to convert every HTML table to arrays of row objects. Use this when you need particular data (prices, lists, specs, tabular data) rather than the whole page. Honors per-domain auth and proxies.

all.description: Return every match as an array instead of the first

attr.description: Extract this attribute (e.g. href, src) instead of text

selectors.description: Map of field name to CSS selector, e.g. {"title":"h1","price":".price","links":{"selector":"a.item","attr":"href","all":true}}

tables.description: Extract all HTML tables as arrays of row objects (default true when no selectors are given)

timeoutMs.description: Overall retrieval deadline in milliseconds, including downloads (default 25000)

name: extract
title: Extract structured data
